messages:
carol_ml: Heads-up — bringing cedar-14k-int8 into canary today. Quick smoke shows token alignment drift after ~38k tokens, outputs start repeating short fragments. Repro script below, pinging folks who worked on RoPE scaling.
sam_eng: thanks. can you paste the minimal repro? curious if it's kv cache related or rotary phase mismatch.
carol_ml: repro steps: 1) load cedar-14k-int8 build 2026-03-18 2) generate with long prompt (~40k tokens) 3) stream tokens; observed drift ~38k-40k
carol_ml: snippet:
```
# run locally on dev-gpu
python run_infer.py --model cedar-14k-int8 --prompt-file long_story.txt --max-tokens 45000 --stream
```
Observed: after ~38k tokens model restarts repeating a 6-token motif and then produces token shifts (off-by-n) vs fp16 baseline.
zara_research: hypothesis: quantized rotary scaling factor not being applied consistently when KV cache rolls/shrinks. iirc cedar uses fused rotary with per-block scale table; int8 path might be skipping a rescale at window-shear boundary.
lee_infra: checking node logs for that canary run now. kvcache metrics show hit_rate dropping from 0.98 -> 0.72 around same time. also saw a burst of cache-evict events.
dave_oncall: i ran the provided script on canary pool (node rwd-canary-7). raw excerpt from the runtime log:
```
[2026-03-21 09:12:41] kvcache: prefill_len=38912
[2026-03-21 09:12:41] kvcache: eviction_policy=window-shear
[2026-03-21 09:12:42] runtime: applied_rotary_scale=false (int8 path)
[2026-03-21 09:12:42] trace: kv_index_shift=+64
[2026-03-21 09:12:42] output: repeating motif detected
```
sam_eng: ah that log line stands out — "applied_rotary_scale=false" on int8 path. do we have a guard that skips scaling when kv_index_shift != 0 ?
zara_research: looks like a regression from the int8 fusion PR that made scale application lazy for perf reasons. probably fine for short contexts but with very long windows the lazy path never catches up after a shift.
carol_ml: impact: quality regression vs cedar-14k-fp16 baseline at long-context benchmarks (long-story, chain-of-thought transcripts). we should fail-canary until we confirm.
lee_infra: created issue: https://redwood.company/issue/ML-1738 linking logs and sample outputs. tagging @sam_eng for infra fix and @zara_research for evals.
qa_bot: New test job queued: long-context-regression/cedar-14k-int8-rollback-check (job id 2026-03-21-77). Will run deterministic compare to fp16 baseline.
sam_eng: quick mitigation idea: force-apply rotary rescale in runtime hotpath during kv index shifts. cheap hack: if kv_index_shift != 0 then call rescale_planes() before next forward.
dave_oncall: that patch seems safe for canary, perf cost ~0.8% per token based on microbench. worth it to avoid regression.
zara_research: also want to re-run quant calibration for rotary factors — current quant table built on 8k contexts; need a 48k calibration pass. adding a job to bench.
carol_ml: agreed. plan: 1) patch runtime to always apply rotary rescale on kv shift (sam) 2) run QA job (qa_bot) 3) rerun calibration and long-context eval (zara) 4) hold canary rollout until pass
sam_eng: i'll open a PR now, target quick revertable change. will add a feature flag int8_rotary_strict=true. rolling to canary tomorrow morning once CI green.
lee_infra: after PR, i will re-run the canary fleet smoke and capture kvcache telemetry + token diffs.
carol_ml: thanks team. attaching a short sample of diffed output (fp16 vs int8) in case useful:
```
..fp16: "The caravan moved on without delay and the lanterns swayed..."
..int8: "The caravan moved on without delay and the lanterns swayed... The caravan moved on without delay and the"
```
carol_ml: that repetition pattern is exactly what we see across several prompts.
sam_eng: ack. i'll annotate the PR with the log excerpts you pasted. if anyone finds other oddities (different motifs, earlier drift), paste here. :eyes: 
zara_research: i'll queue the 48k calibration job and attach eval metrics to ML-1738. marking this a high-priority regression.
dave_oncall: leaving some test seeds in the issue — reproducible on rwd-canary-7 with seed 42.
carol_ml: cool. i'm going to freeze canary rollouts for cedar-14k-int8 for now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
